steps.title: Prepare Environmental Samples
steps.instruction: Prepare the specific sample type for processing using the following volumes and methods:

substeps.instruction: For drinking water: Take 200 mL in sterile 200 mL polypropylene centrifuge tubes.
For left over feed samples: Add 5 mL of sample to 95 mL of autoclaved Milli-Q water in sterile falcons.
For manger swabs: Transfer the EDC into 50 mL of PBS in a sterile centrifuge tube.

steps.title: Clarify Samples
steps.instruction: Remove solid debris from the prepared samples.

substeps.instruction: Vortex all samples thoroughly to mix properly.
Squeeze EDC using a sterile spatula to recover the maximum amount of PBS.
Centrifuge all samples at 8000 rpm for 20 minutes.
Carefully transfer the clear supernatant to new sterile centrifuge tubes (100 mL or 200 mL, depending on original volume), avoiding the pellet.

steps.title: Concentrate Virus Particles
steps.instruction: Concentrate the virus particles from the supernatant using PEG and NaCl.

substeps.instruction: Add 10% (w/v) PEG-8000 and 1 M NaCl to the collected supernatant.
Vigorously mix by shaking or inverting until PEG and NaCl dissolve completely.
Carefully decant the supernatant without disturbing the pellet at the bottom of the tube.
Incubate the samples (duration not specified).
Centrifuge the tubes at 12,000 rpm for 90 minutes at 4°C.
Carefully decant the supernatant and gently remove any remaining liquid without dislodging the pellet.

steps.title: Resuspend and Store Sample
steps.instruction: Recover the concentrated virus pellet for storage.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL of nuclease-free water.
Vortex briefly to ensure complete resuspension.
Store the resuspended sample at -20°C until further use.

steps.title: Prepare qPCR Reaction
steps.instruction: Set up the real-time PCR reaction using the Applied Biosystems 7500 system.

substeps.instruction: Thaw qPCR reagents and samples on ice and briefly spin down.
Set up a master mix for the number of samples plus negative and positive controls, including one or two extra reactions to account for pipetting error.
Aliquot 20 µL of mastermix into each required well of a 96-well plate or 8-well optical strips and caps.
Seal the plate with an optical adhesive seal and spin down briefly to gather reagents and remove bubbles.

steps.title: Run qPCR and Analyze Results
steps.instruction: Execute the PCR cycling and evaluate the detection of Lumpy Skin Disease Virus (LSDV).

substeps.instruction: Load the plate into the real-time PCR machine and carry out cycling according to the specified conditions.
Once the run is completed, set the threshold above background noise.
Assess the normalized Ct values for each gene target for each sample and determine positivity using the cut-off Ct values derived from standards.
